title: test-budget annotations off the 10 s grid (cli audit-mail-bodies archive test: 85) make the weekly shard-timings refresh refuse its readings; only the weekly generator checks the grid
body:
## Finding

Raised by the #25390 card thread (`session_01V7SdBWbSZCQFPJD4ofKPPc`) as an out-of-scope finding. The `domain:devx` seat files it on that thread's behalf. Filed bare: grading and routing are triage's job. ⛔ Not a claim.

**What happened.** The 2026-10-23 refresh run of `shard-timings-refresh.yml` (relay dispatch 39951977591, which opened PR #25409) refused its regression diff on `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/audit-mail-bodies.archive.integration.test.ts:2`, which reads `test-budget: 85`. That value is off the 10 s grid. The 2026-10-19 refresh was refused the same way, by a 15 s cli file.

**Why it matters.** Only the weekly generator checks the grid. So every off-grid budget that lands silently disables the next refresh's readings, and nothing at PR time says so. The dataset in #25409 is not affected.

## Two producers, for triage to route

1. **The file itself (S, likely `domain:cli`):** change 85 to 90, or to whatever value on the grid the measured time supports.
2. **The missing PR-time check (tooling):** a lint or check that refuses an off-grid `test-budget:` annotation when it is written, using the same grid rule the generator applies.

Dedupe words: test-budget grid, shard-timings-refresh regression diff, off-grid budget.
